title: Titan Cassini VIMS Global color ratio mosaic (32ppd) (Titan_global_32ppd_ColorRatio_v2)

relations.evidence: Trek product description: 'For details on the approach used for generating this map, please refer to Le Mouelic et al. ... doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2018.09.017'

statements.text: Stéphane Le Mouélic (producer); NASA/Caltech-JPL/University of Arizona/LPG Nantes
8-bit display levels without scale, offset or no-data tags; the mosaic may still contain artifacts and clouds, and its spatial and intensity calibration could be improved (Trek product description).

No reuse terms are stated on the Trek product. The producer's VIMS portal distributes its VIMS data under CC BY 4.0 with the credit NASA/Caltech-JPL/University of Arizona/Osuna-CNRS-Nantes Université.
